release_notes: 922 Setup creates Teams cards again - a regression in 0.8.6.11 meant the card post was accepted but no cards were created; re-running the stage is safe and never duplicates. FORMED tags now land on the plate, not the rod, for parts carrying both under one part number - re-run FormingFinder then Kitting on an affected batch to reprint. LST reports no longer count one tube twice when the PO and the shop file spell its revision letter differently, and the 911 organizer gets the same matching. Batch Repeater now checks each pulled repeat for its shop-print cut files up front instead of the gap surfacing on the end-of-batch LST report.
